Top-Rated Heating & Cooling Services in Northern NJ and NYC

We’re trained to handle all your heating and air conditioning needs for your satisfaction.

At Integrate Comfort Systems, we take immense pride in our quality of work and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction. We never take shortcuts; we do the job right the first time. When you choose us for your heating and air conditioning needs, you’re making the best decision for your home or business.

Driven by a higher purpose to serve our customers and community, we’re dedicated to providing the best possible service at a fair price. We stand by our work and are always here to help you maximize your investment, even if you didn’t purchase your system from us. We’re happy to assist with maintenance and repairs.

We understand that a malfunctioning system can be a major inconvenience, which is why we offer 24/7 emergency service. You’re never left hanging—we’re here for you when you need us, and we’ll work swiftly to get your system back up and running.

Count on us for all your heating and air conditioning needs, whether it’s a new installation, repairs, or maintenance. We prioritize your comfort and never cut corners in an industry where it’s easy to do so. We’re the team you can trust for honest, reliable service.

Contact Us Today
The ICS Difference
Respect

We believe in treating our customers, employees, and partners with respect. As a family-owned business, we understand the importance of treating people like family.

Learn More
Transparency

In everything we do, we believe in being open and honest. We’ll always give you straightforward information so you can make the best decision for your needs.

Learn More
Accountability

The ability to stand behind our work is important to us. We’re not happy unless you’re happy. If there’s ever a problem, we’ll make it right.

Learn More
Integrity

We’re honest, reliable, and hardworking. We do what we say we’re going to do, and we always put our customers first.

Learn More
We Increase Comfort while Reducing Operational Costs — Even in the Toughest Climates
GETTING IT RIGHT THE FIRST TIME.

For nearly three decades, ICS has successfully completed over 15,000+ installations heating and cooling system installations across New York City and New Jersey. As certified specialists in cold-climate heat pump technology, we deliver reliable year-round comfort while reducing operating costs.

From fabrication and design to long-term maintenance and emergency service, our commitment to experience, efficiency, and excellence has made us a regional leader in HVAC and advanced heat pump solutions.

FAMILY OWNED · THREE NJ OFFICES
FAMILY OWNED HVAC SINCE 1990

Integrate Comfort Systems is a family-owned heating and cooling contractor working out of Carlstadt, Belleville and Englewood Cliffs. We have been doing this in Northern New Jersey and New York City since 1990, and the work is still run the way a family business runs it.

WATCH · WHY WE TEACH INSTEAD OF SELL
THE WORST HVAC ADVICE EVER

Most of what goes wrong in this trade starts with advice that sounds sensible. Match the old size. Skip the load calculation. We put videos out because a homeowner who understands the decision does not need to be sold anything.

Video & Press Room
See Our Work
OUR STORY
THIRTY-FIVE YEARS OF INTEGRATE COMFORT SYSTEMS

We started in 1990 as a service company in Bergen County, working on furnaces and boilers that were already old then. The footprint grew outward: Hudson and Passaic, then Essex and Union, then Morris, Sussex and Warren, then across the river into the five boroughs. The commercial side grew the same way, out of buildings whose owners already knew us from a house.

Family ownership is not a decoration on that history; it decides what we can do. Nobody here has to hit a monthly replacement number, so a technician who finds a sound system with a failed part is free to say so. That is the difference between a company you call twice and one you call for twenty years.

Today the residential and commercial sides share one shop, one set of standards and one licence. The physics does not care which building it is in.

Founded 1990 · still family owned and family run
More than 15,000 installations across the region
Residential, commercial and in-house sheet metal fabrication
Nine New Jersey counties and the five boroughs
COMFORT UP, OPERATING COST DOWN
Size to the Load
A Manual J heat loss and gain, not the nameplate on the box we are removing.
Fix the Duct First
Restricted duct wastes every efficiency point you paid for.
Commission It
Airflow, temperature rise, charge and combustion written down at handover.
Keep the Record
The same readings every year, so drift shows up as a number rather than a complaint.
WHERE WE WORK FROM
THREE OFFICES, ONE STANDARD

Trucks are dispatched from three locations, so the drive to you is across a county rather than across the state.

CARLSTADT — SHOP & WAREHOUSE

736 Gotham Parkway. Shop, warehouse and sheet metal floor. Covers Bergen, Hudson, Passaic and New York City, and fabricates duct for every job we run.

Carlstadt office
BELLEVILLE — MAIN OFFICE

267 Cortlandt Street. Covers Essex, Union and Morris, and reaches Sussex and Warren as scheduled work rather than same-day service.

Belleville office
ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS

120 Charlotte Place, Suite 201. Eastern Bergen and the George Washington Bridge corridor, which is how we get into upper Manhattan quickly.

Englewood Cliffs office
All Service Areas
What We Do
CREDENTIALS
WHAT WE ARE CERTIFIED TO DO

Every one of these is a card somebody had to sit an exam for, and it is checked before a technician works alone.

NATE-CERTIFIED

North American Technician Excellence certification, the trade’s own competence test, across gas, hydronic and heat pump work.

MITSUBISHI DIAMOND

Mitsubishi Electric Diamond and Elite contractor status for ductless and multi-zone systems, including ceiling cassettes.

COLD-CLIMATE HEAT PUMPS

Cold-climate heat pump certified, which is what a New Jersey January actually asks of a heat pump installation.

NJ DEVILS PARTNER

An affiliate partner of the New Jersey Devils — a hometown association, in a state we have worked in since 1990.

TALK TO THE PEOPLE WHO WILL DO THE WORK

Ask us anything about a system, a building or a proposal you have been handed. No obligation on either side.

(866) 749-6331

Since 1990 — more than thirty-five years in the same region, and over 15,000 installations. A fair share of the service calls we run today are on systems we put in ourselves.
